semantic_fragments.content: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members' health conditions easily and quickly.

The risk management activity including the risk management plan was began at the time the project is approved. This risk management review is to assess the harm and make the risk analysis, evaluation, and proposed the risk control plan.

Risk evaluation criteria: Please find the document Risk Management Plan (PT9L-FXJH01 V1.0) for the risk acceptance criteria. Severity scale: 1 Negligible; 2 Minor; 3 Serious; 4 Critical; 5 Catastrophic. Probability scale: 1 Few; 2 Improbable; 3 Remote; 4 Occasional; 5 Probable; 6 Frequent.

Document structure covers: Signification of Abbreviations; Overview (product introduction, risk management plan implementation, risk management group); Criteria for risk evaluation; Identify medical device characteristics that could impact on safety and intended use (bibliography, questions from Annex A of ISO/TR 24971:2020, questions from IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020 Edition 3.2, additional questions from IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 edition 4.1); Risk analysis, risk evaluation and PRM; Risk Management Conclusion; Signature of the risk management group.

A.2.1 What is the intended use and how is the medical device to be used? It is not recommended for people whose measuring part has local lesions, such as inflammation, trauma, postoperative, etc. The IFT is not intended for sustaining or supporting life, so special intervention might not be necessary in case of its failure. The occurrence of information security failure can affect data confidentiality and may lead to a decline in performance or a loss of availability. Unauthorized access, unauthorized activities, or data loss may affect the safety of the device.
A.2.3 The product is intended to be in contact with the skin in short time, giving rise to conceivable hazards from chemical agents and immunological agents.

A.2.4 Materials and components: Not intended for use or contact with other materials or components; not intended for contact with tissues or body fluids; safety-relevant characteristics are known; no materials of animal origin were used.

A.2.5 Energy delivered to or extracted from the patient: Yes, infrared energy is extracted from the patient. The type of energy transferred is electromagnetic wave. Measurement time is the relevant control parameter. Energy levels are not higher than those currently used for similar medical devices.

A.2.9 The medical device is intended to be routinely cleaned and disinfected by the user; routine cleaning and sterilization of the probe is required. Conceivable hazards include biological agents, chemical agents, and immunological agents.
A.2.11 Measurements taken: Yes, the device measures body temperature. Conceivable hazards relate to Data and Functionality.

A.2.14 Unwanted outputs of energy: Yes, including non-ionizing radiation, electrical energy, and thermal energy. No unwanted outputs of substances. Conceivable hazards: Radiation energy, Electric energy, Thermal energy.

A.2.15 The medical device is susceptible to environmental influences including temperature, humidity, electromagnetic interference, atmospheric pressure, vibration, dust, light, and insects. Conceivable hazards: Radiation energy, Functionality.
A.2.16 The medical device impacts the environment through electromagnetic radiation, battery usage, and scrappage. Conceivable hazards: Radiation energy, Chemical agents.
A.2.17 The medical device requires consumables or accessories: Yes, batteries. Conceivable hazards: Functionality, Thermal energy.
A.2.18 Maintenance or calibration is necessary and should be performed by trained professionals.

A.2.19 The medical device contains software. For non-connected models, no installation and verification are required. However, App connected models or Bluetooth models applied require software installation and verification. Conceivable hazard: Software hazards.
A.2.20 The medical device allows access to information, but only for models with Bluetooth functionality. Conceivable hazard: Data.
Section 3.1 Bibliography: Please find Attachment 'Harmonised Standards List' for the applicable harmonised standards referenced in this risk analysis.

ISO/TR 24971:2020 Annex A questions matrix summarising the characteristics of the IFT (Infrared Forehead Thermometer) that could impact safety and intended use, covering energy types, materials, environment, software, maintenance, and data security aspects. Conceivable hazard categories identified include: Electric energy, Mechanical energy, Biological agents, Chemical agents, Immunological agents, Data, Functionality, Electromagnetic wave, Radiation energy, Thermal energy, Software hazards.

A.2.21: 医疗器械存储对患者护理至关重要的数据——存储体温测量值（Data）。A.2.22: 仅有使用寿命，无特定货架寿命限制（Functionality, Electric energy）。A.2.23: 存在延迟或长期使用效应——标签磨损（Functionality）。A.2.24: 不受机械力影响（N/A）。A.2.25: 使用寿命由组件老化决定（Functionality）。A.2.26: 非一次性使用器械（N/A）。A.2.27: 需要安全报废或处置，包括器械本身的适当处置和存储数据的妥善处理（Chemical agents, Data）。A.2.28: 安装或使用不需要特殊培训或技能（N/A）。A.2.29: 安全使用信息通过制造商提供的用户手册直接传达给终端用户，无需额外培训（Mechanical energy, Thermal energy, Electric energy, Radiation energy, Functionality, Chemical agents）。A.2.30: 未建立或引入新的制造工艺（N/A）。

A.2.31系列问题：用户界面相关分析。A.2.31: 器械成功应用不依赖用户界面可用性（N/A）。A.2.31.1: 用户界面设计特性不会导致使用错误（N/A）。A.2.31.2: 器械不在可能导致使用错误的紧急医疗环境中使用（N/A）。A.2.31.3: 器械无连接件或附件（N/A）。A.2.31.4: 器械无控制界面（N/A）。A.2.31.5: 器械显示测量值和警告信息（Functionality）。A.2.31.6: 器械不由菜单控制，仅有简单按钮或直接控制操作（N/A）。A.2.31.7: 器械成功使用不依赖用户的知识、技能和能力（N/A）。A.2.31.8: 器械不被有特殊需求的人员使用（N/A）。A.2.31.9: 用户界面不允许访问受限操作模式，不能发起未授权操作（N/A）。

A.2.32: 器械包含技术报警系统（Functionality）。A.2.33: 可能的误用方式包括：用于非预期人群、不当环境、不当维护或连接失败（Functionality）。A.2.34: 器械为便携式设备（Mechanical energy）。A.2.35: 器械的使用依赖基本性能（Functionality）。A.2.36: 器械具有一定自主性——启动测量后自动执行测量过程，遇到问题时发出虚假警告（Functionality）。A.2.37: 器械产生的输出不用作确定临床行动的输入（N/A）。

IEC 60601-1相关问题回答：4.3条款——器械的基本性能为临床温度计的测量精度。4.4条款——预期使用寿命为5年。4.5条款——标准要求无特定风险控制措施，不需要替代手段。4.6条款——应用部分为按键和外壳，两者均可被触碰，但按键和外壳无需满足应用部分要求。4.7条款——除13.2子条款识别的单一故障条件外，可行的单一故障条件为温度限制装置发生故障。4.8条款——所有组件均按其规定额定值和标准使用。4.9条款——无高完整性特性组件。5.1条款——不会发生同时故障的组合。
IEC 60601-1标签与包装相关问题：7.2.2条款——考虑了标签标记的可预见误用。7.2.13条款——器械不产生生理效应。7.2.17条款——运输或储存有特殊处理说明，提前去除包装不会对产品或附件造成不可接受的风险。7.3.3条款——锂电池有警告标签，干电池无警告标签。

IEC/EN 60601-1 checklist responses covering electrical, mechanical, radiation, and thermal safety considerations for the medical device. Key findings include: (7.4.2) Control devices use symbol-indicated switches. (7.5) Warning, Prohibition, and Mandatory action safety signs are used. (7.9.2.4) Low battery and battery leakage risks are addressed; battery leakage risk is acceptable with instruction manual warning to remove battery during prolonged non-use; loss of power can lead to unacceptable risk, design allows rapid pressure release on power loss. (7.9.3.2) No replaceable fuses, power supply cords, or other such parts. (8.8.4.1) Reinforced insulation case requires specific heat resistance test protocols. (8.10.1) Inner lead component is securely mounted for expected service lifetime. (9.2.1) Moving parts cannot be touched during intended function. (9.2.3.1) Controls are positioned/recessed/protected to prevent accidental actuation; no unacceptable risk created. (9.6.1) Noise and vibration levels ≤80 dBA. (10.6) Infrared probe produces infrared radiation. (11.1.3) Test corner influences ventilation near the medical device.
11.1.3 接触概率与接触时长：测量体温时必须接触按键和外壳，外壳接触时间<1分钟，按键接触时间<1分钟，温度符合IEC 60601-1表22和表23的要求。
11.6.5 防水防尘等级：设备防护等级为IP22。
11.6.6 多次清洁/消毒对医疗器械及其附件的影响：多次清洁/消毒后设备不损坏。
11.6.7 灭菌：正常使用和可预见误用情况下无需灭菌。
11.6.8 接触物质：产品与皮肤接触。
11.3 防火外壳：无此类部件。设备功耗低于15W，不存在火灾风险。
14.13 PEMS通过网络/数据耦合连接到其他设备：采用蓝牙连接。
15.4.3.2 电池连接：Battery connection（电池连接）。
15.4.4 指示器说明：有开机指示。没有非发光加热器。输出电路意外和长时间运行不构成危险情况。
17 电磁兼容：被测设备已测试并符合IEC 60601-1-2标准要求。
排除环境说明：设备不适合在活动HF外科设备附近以及磁共振成像ME系统的RF屏蔽室中使用，因为这些环境中的电磁干扰强度较高。
免疫测试通过/失败判据（基本安全）：包括可触及部件及应用部件的爬电距离和空气间隙、介电强度、泄漏电流及患者辅助电流的测量。
工作模式测试说明：发射测试时，被测设备（EUT）配置为测量其最高可能的发射电平，测试条件参照使用说明书进行调整；免疫测试时，EUT配置为对被测现象具有最高可能的敏感性，测试条件参照使用说明书进行调整。
预期使用环境为专业医疗机构环境和家庭医疗保健环境，不会改变本附属标准IEC 60601-1-2规定的合理可预见电磁干扰水平。电磁免疫测试按照用户手册中定义的体温计进行。
端口测试说明：设备对特定调制频率或频率范围不敏感，按照表4-表8中列出的频率进行测试。涉及外壳端口、输入交流电源端口、输入直流电源端口、患者耦合端口及SIP/SOP端口。
RF无线通信设备近场免疫：未遇到额外频率和通信，参见使用说明书。电磁免疫测试按照用户手册中定义的体温计进行。
9 kHz至13.56 MHz频率范围内近场磁场免疫：该产品没有任何对磁场敏感的元器件或电路。
测试配置确定方法：不同系列产品将分别进行测试；如果产品属于同一系列（例如相似电路、相似功能），则选择能覆盖最全面电路和功能的产品进行测试。

Risk analysis table section 4.1 Energy hazards covers: Electromagnetic energy, Electrostatic discharge, Radiated RF EM fields, Conducted disturbances induced by RF fields, Proximity fields from RF wireless communications, Rated Power-frequency Magnetic Field, Proximity magnetic fields immunity test, Leakage current, Separation parts, Parts contacting patient, Temperature of parts, Temperature of applied parts, Mechanical strength, Inner lead, Component fixing, Protective measures components, Infrared radiation. Items marked N/A include: Acoustic energy, Moving parts, Lithium battery, Suspended masses, Vibration, Stored Energy, Torsion/shear/tensile force, Moving and positioning of patient, Ultrasonic energy, Infrasound energy, High pressure fluid injection.

Risk analysis table section 4.2 Biological and chemical hazards covers: Allergenicity/Irritancy (biocompatibility not qualified leading to allergies/irritation/cytotoxicity), Allergenicity/Irritancy (failure to clean applied part on time or device sharing leading to infection/cross-infection). Items marked N/A include: Bacteria, Viruses, Other agents, Exposure of airway/tissues/environment to foreign materials, Degradation products/medical gas/anesthesia products, Pyrogenicity.

For each unacceptable Risk, we have considered risk control measures according to the principle of section 3.3 'Risk Acceptance Criteria' in RMP. For each acceptable risk, we have further implemented risk control measures. So I think we have reduced the risk AFAP.

Risk level matrix before control: Severity levels (1 Negligible to 5 Catastrophic) vs Probability levels (1 Few to 6 Frequent). R50 at Frequent/Serious; R36 at Occasional/Minor; R9,R10,R11,R13,R15,R16,R17,R18,R20,R21,R22,R26,R27,R28,R29,R30,R33,R34,R37,R39,R40,R42,R43,R44,R46,R51,R52,R53 at Occasional/Serious; R56 at Remote/Negligible; R23 at Remote/Minor; R24,R38,R54,R55,R57 at Remote/Serious; R3,R8 at Remote/Critical; R12,R19,R25,R31,R32,R35,R41,R45,R47,R48,R49 at Improbable/Serious; R1,R2,R4,R5,R6,R7,R14 at Improbable/Critical. Risks in white background area are ACC (acceptable), others need to be controlled.
According to the above risk analysis and assessment, the software security level is determined as B.

Wireless coexistence risk detail: The APP provides display and storage functions. If the app cannot receive the result, the LED of IFT can display the result. When the interference disappears, the next Bluetooth transmission can upload the data lost last time. Therefore, even if the app cannot display the current results, or the app delays the display of the current results, it will not cause harm to the user, but will increase the user's inconvenience.
